text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of Agnes Tachyon's momentous debut race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But instead of worrying about the race, she's worried instead about how she ran out of tea.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Showing no signs of pre-race jitters, she casually makes for the track.
